business_scope: Seasonal price trend analysis, APMC arrival cycles, storage arbitrage economics, and marketing strategy advisory for onions in Maharashtra and major Indian markets.

crop_business_factors.details: Nashik and Lasalgaon onion markets face severe price crashes during the major Kharif harvest arrival window between October and December due to sudden supply surges.

Rabi onions harvested in April-May have better shelf life. Farmers utilizing low-cost naturally ventilated storage structures can hold produce and sell between June and September to capture 30% to 40% higher price premiums.

common_risks.details: Sudden export bans, minimum export price (MEP) restrictions, or stock limits can abruptly depress domestic prices and trap held inventory.
common_risks.source: Ministry of Consumer Affairs / Economic Survey

common_risks.details: Holding onions for price recovery exposes the farmer to physical weight loss, sprouting, and fungal rotting if ventilation is inadequate.

market_factors.factor: Local vs. regional mandi price differentials
market_factors.details: Comparing local assembly market rates against major hub markets like Lasalgaon after factoring in transportation costs and commission fees.

cost_factors: Storage structure depreciation or rental costs
Sorting, grading, bagging, and freight expenses
revenue_factors: Modal market price per quintal at the time of targeted release
Net marketable bulb volume remaining after storage shrinkage
cost_revenue_factors.important_rule: The decision to store rabi onions must balance projected price appreciation against physical storage loss percentage and market policy volatility.
cost_revenue_factors.source: Agricultural Economics and Farm Management Studies

strengths: Clear historical seasonal price cycles enabling strategic planning.
weaknesses: Smallholders lack individual holding capacity, often forcing distress sales.
opportunities: Using digital market advisory tools to time dispatches to high-price regional mandis.
threats: Sudden regulatory export policy changes and unseasonal weather disrupting storage.

things_to_monitor: Daily modal prices and arrival volumes in nearby APMC mandis
Government policy notifications on export duties or stock limits
Sprouting and rot percentages in stored inventory lots
